$comment: Ownership manifest for the Ferst thin-client. `upstream` = where scaffold updates come from (this template). `ownedPaths` = TEMPLATE-owned, force-synced from upstream on every `npm run update` (never hand-edit them in a client). `seedPaths` = scaffold copied ONCE at seed time but NOT force-synced, because a client may legitimately customise them (e.g. astro.config redirects, .gitignore additions). `clientPaths` = the client's own data (generated at seed, never touched by an update). `coreRange` = the ferst-core version this scaffold targets. See docs/UPDATING.md and CLAUDE.md.
